newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends flat, cooled by drop in PC stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends flat, cooled by drop in PC stocks.

text.p: Nasdaq shares ended flat on Friday, as a drop in personal computer stocks cooled the rest of the technology sector, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained less than a point, up 0.49 points or 0.03 percent to close unofficially at 1569.62. Advancing issues beat decliners 11 to 10 on total volume of 662 million shares. Nasdaq shares have traded higher in seven of the past 10 sessions.

Dell Computer Corp, the most active Nasdaq issue, slipped from its recent highs, falling 7 to 163. Investors took profits after the dazzling rally in PC stocks as Gateway 2000 Inc's second quarter earnings met expectation but still included disappointing elements that provided an excuse to sell, analysts said.

"The market was a bit tired today. The techs especially. After the jump in PC stocks, which just had quite a run lately, people just decided to cash in their chips before the weekend," said one trader.

Intel Corp, which plans to slash certain chip prices up to 50 percent, lost 9/16 to 89-3/16. PairGain Technologies Inc jumped 1-1/16 to 21-15/16 on rumors that Lucent Technologies is preparing to buy the company.
